mission_02: Excellent! You have successfully implemented z-score standardization from scratch. You learned how the formula z = (x - mean) / std transforms data to have zero mean and unit variance. Z-score standardization is the most commonly used scaling method in machine learning because it works well with algorithms that assume normally distributed features. Unlike min-max scaling, z-scores are not bounded, which means they handle new data points gracefully without requiring re-scaling of the entire dataset.
